sentences.text:
Harishankar Chapadi vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party on 21
April, 2023

Author: S.K. Sahoo
Bench: S.K. Sahoo
 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
 Blapl No.3331 of 2023

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Mr. J.K. Khuntia, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha .... Opp. Party
 Mrs. Susamarani Sahoo
 Addl.

Standing Counsel
 Coram:
 Justice S.K. Sahoo
 Order
Order No. 21.04.2023
01.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

This is an application for bail under section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with Jeypore Mahila P.S.
Case No. 12 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 101 of 2023 pending in the file of learned S.D.J.M., Jeypore for alleged commission of offences under sections 376(2)(n)/ 417 of the Indian Penal Code.
The prayer for bail of the petitioner was rejected by the learned Sessions Judge, Koraput, Jeypore vide order dated 16.03.2023.
Considering the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is in judicial custody since 13.01.2023

, charge sheet has already been // 2 // submitted under sections 376(2)(n)/417 of the Indian Penal Code and the victim is a major girl, who stated about her love affairs and keeping physical relationship with the petitioner on the assurance of marriage given by the petitioner and after hearing the learned counsel for the State, I am inclined to release the petitioner on bail.
Harishankar Chapadi vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179685047/

entities.text: Harishankar Chapadi vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1 Let the petitioner be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/-
(rupees fifty thousand) with two local solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin over the matter with further conditions as the learned Court below may deem just and proper including the conditions that the petitioner shall not keep any contact either with the victim or any of the prosecution witnesses, shall not indulge in any criminal activities and shall appear before the learned trial Court on each date to which the case would be posted for trial.
Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
Issue urgent certified copy as per Rules.
( S.K. Sahoo) Judge PKSahoo Harishankar Chapadi vs State Of Odisha ....
